Name: (CP) Let them stay friends
Author: Enri0425
Description:
Does it bother you the fact that once you achieve enough friendship with some marriage candidates, they stop hanging out with their "rival"? Me too!
This mod changes some marriage candidates' schedules so that they still hang out with their "rival" once you reach 6 hearts of friendship with either or both of them.
Specifically, the edits I made are:
[list]
[*]Abigail and Sebastian keep hanging out together in Seb's room on the 11th and 25th of each season;
[*]Alex and Haley will always hang out together in Haley and Emily's house every Wednesday;
[*]Elliott will hang out with Leah in the Saloon on Friday;
[*]Penny and Sam will hang out on the bridge near the Library on the 9th and 23rd of each season
[/list]
Also, if you have Generic Mod Config Tool installed, you can choose which pair of characters will keep hanging out together or not. Uncheck the pairs you don't want.
WARNING: Sometimes characters won't hang out together due to their schedule being overridden by a rainy day, by some festivals etc.
You need the latest versions of SMAPI and Content Patcher for this mod to work.
EDIT: It was brought to my attention that a few years ago someone had the same idea as me and made a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7926]mod similar to mine[/url], so you should also go check that one out before installing this one.
